Lane.description: `[lane."<team>/<theme>"]`: how the queue treats one lane.

max_running.description:
The most of the lane's tasks that may have a live run at once; new starts past it wait.
With `when`, only inside that window.

max_running_outside.description: The most that may run at once outside `when`; no cap when unset.

Rule.description:
A rule sets at least one of `key`, `team`, `project` and `branch`, and matches a task that fits
each one it sets.

branch.description: A pattern for the task's branch, in which `*` matches any run of characters.

project.description: The project of the task's source event, exactly.

team.description: The team of the task's source event, exactly.

Window.description: The days and hours a filter or a lane's cap applies, in `timezone`.

days.description:
The weekdays it applies on; every day when unset. With `hours` that pass midnight, the day
the hours start on.

hours.description: The hours it applies, `HH:MM-HH:MM`, which may pass midnight; the whole day when unset.

timezone.description:
The IANA zone the days and hours are read in, such as `Europe/Paris`; the machine's own
when unset, which a filter allows only in a factory of one runner.

description:
`lanes.toml`: how a task without a lane of its own gets one. Without the file, every task gets
the `{team}/misc` fallback.

fallback.description: A lane, in which `{team}` stands for the task's team, or `none` without one.

lane.description: Each lane's settings, by its `<team>/<theme>` name.

rules.description: The rules, tried in order: the first that matches gives the lane.

title: lanes
